notes:
High-level: Mid-market analytics SaaS, product search + recommendations. Primary ask: replace noisy keyword search with semantic search for in-app product discovery and related-item recommendations. Evaluation track: start Hosted API for quick POC -> move to Dedicated for predictable cost and throughput if results are good.

Key business metrics / requirements: p95 query latency <= 120ms (live search), nightly batch embed job needs to process ~1M new vectors over a 48-72h window (target sustained throughput ~4-8k embeds/min during batch), cost sensitivity: avoid >30% increase in infra spend year-over-year.

Security/compliance: EU data residency for EU tenants, SOC2 required; legal asks for DPA + data residency clause before Prod. SSO (SAML) + audit logs mandatory.

POC summary: used Hosted API (embeddings) + Weaviate managed cluster for vector store. Baseline: quality of semantic matches improved recall by ~18% on curated prompt set. Identified hot-paths: large batch ingestion stress (timeout/retry behavior), rate-limiter tuning, connector stability between Redwood and Weaviate.

Technical notes from meetings: 
- "We liked how the hosted API got us moving quickly — no infra work for initial proof." 
- Discussed Dedicated to control token price on large nightly runs and to meet residency needs.
- SE validated Redwood's prefix/KV cache behavior vs our query patterns; potential to reduce token count on repeated user sessions.
- Concern: need deterministic cost model for batch jobs (flat compute units vs per-token spikes).

Questions outstanding: model quantization options for embeddings, recommended batch parallelism, integration patterns for Airflow + Redwood SDK, expected p95 under Dedicated 3-GPU pool with our payload sizes.

Sales/Commercial: asked for 3-month pilot commit number; procurement wants an estimate for a 12-month reserved capacity.
